94414.text: Speak with Halaan Hawk-Eye and borrow his gift to view the anchor pylon in the distance.

94486.text: Collect 20 feathers from the Shadowgale Shrieklings in Shadowgale Forest.

94487.text: Collect 10 Bloodied Heirlooms from Al'Aketh Footsoldiers and Al'Aketh Stormchasers in the Shadowgale Forest.

94488.text: Kill Commander Haalien and bring his head to Elegael Thornpaw in the Shadowgale Forest.

94493.text: Speak with Elegael Thornpaw in the northeastern part of Shadowgale Forest.

94497.text: Fill the Empty Brown Waterskin at the bottom of the waterfalls below Hervdana's cave and return it to her in the Wetlands.

94499.text: Fill the Empty Red Waterskin at Stonewatch Falls near the Nightcrawler Murlocs and return to Hervdana Saegrund in the Wetlands.

94500.text: Fill the Unfilled Blue Waterskin at the waters of Astranaar in Ashenvale and return to Hervdana Saegrund in the Wetlands.

94821.text: Speak to High Priestess Mims in Ironforge.

94872.text: Bring the Totem Tote to the Magram Quartermaster at Magram Village in the Desolace to significantly increase your reputation with that clan. You must be of at least Neutral standing with the Magram Clan Centaur.

94896.text: Collect 8 Abandoned Belongings from the ruins of Ban'aethal.

94897.text: Find Resaan in the Ruins of Ban'aethal.

94978.text: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Windsong Crawler found near bodies of water. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar.

94979.text: Use the Taming Rod to tame an Ornery Galestrider in the Gustberry Lowlands. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Quel'ana Quickgale in Valanaar.

95036.text: Speak with Trevan Rol in the Sepulcher and bring him the materials he requires.

95041.text: Collect 7 Gnomeregan Archival Data cards from around Gnomeregan, then deliver them to Jemma Quikswitch in Ironforge.

95216.text: Collect the Highly Toxic Strain from Witherfang in Ruins of Lordaeron for Theodore Griffs in Undercity.

95384.text: Bring the partial scroll to Dudd Fizzlescroll in Booty Bay.

95495.text: Bring the Bundle of Hides to the hermit on the ridge overlooking the Dry Hills in the Barrens.

95507.text: Collect 8 Trapped Game from traps found in Sprung Traps in the Barrens.

95621.text: Travel to the wrecked caravan and learn more about why the Kul Tirans are here.

95770.text: Explore the Vile Reef and find the cavern entrance.

95772.text: Look for Dorin Songblade's brother, Daewyn, in Whelgar's Excavation Site.

95773.text: Gather 10 Brinescale Tridents from Brinescale Skirmishers.

95774.text: Slay quilboars and collect 4 of Olgra's Adornments for Mankrik's memorial.
